purpose: Teach: 珪/聾/鞍/烏/瑤/螢/禄/鄭

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、半導体の珪素、つまり珪原料の調達を強化しろ
lines.en: I want us to strengthen our sourcing of semiconductor silicon—the raw material supply chain.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Authority without sharpness. Brief pause at the em-dash for emphasis on the clarification. Seated, assured posture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。聾、つまり聴覚障害者向けバリアフリー商品を展開します
lines.en: Understood. We'll expand our barrier-free product line for deaf and hard-of-hearing customers.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation. Clear enunciation. Slight nod in the voice. Takes the instruction seriously—not rushing, not over-performing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員旅行の乗馬体験で鞍、つまり鞍の使い方を学べ
lines.en: During the company retreat, I want everyone to learn proper horseback riding technique—specifically saddle handling and safety.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing. Slightly instructional tone, like explaining something important. Pauses at the em-dash to ensure clarity. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。鳥害、つまり烏の対策を倉庫で実施します
lines.en: Understood. We'll implement bird-control measures in the warehouse—dealing with the crow problem we've had.
lines.style: Pragmatic, matter-of-fact. References the known issue with quiet confidence. Direct eye contact implied. Confirms he's understood the practical intent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創業者の旧字「瑤」、つまり瑤を社印に残せ
lines.en: Make sure we preserve the founder's original kanji character for 瑤 in our company seal—keep that heritage visible.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost reverent pacing on the character name. Weight behind the words about heritage. Slight lean forward on importance. Composed but with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品名に旧字「螢」、つまり蛍を採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll incorporate the classical character 蛍 in our new product naming.
lines.style: Confirming understanding with respect for the choice. Slight warmth—recognizing the elegance of the decision. Steady, professional delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、給与体系を「禄」、つまり伝統的安定型に近づけろ
lines.en: Restructure the compensation system to move closer to 禄—the traditional stability model. I want predictability and loyalty rewarded again.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery. Slight pause before the term to let it land. Philosophical undertone without becoming preachy. Measured, reflective.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。中国の鄭社長との取引を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our business dealings with President Zheng's company in China.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slight finality in the tone—this closes the briefing. Professional, no hesitation. Clear commitment to action.
